semiconductor_relevance: High — Hanwha Semitech develops and manufactures semiconductor equipment for both front-end and back-end processes, serving major global semiconductor companies.
summary: Hanwha Semitech specializes in the development and manufacturing of semiconductor equipment, particularly for DRAM, NAND, and CPU production. With over 30 years of experience, the company has expanded its offerings to include both back-end bonding machines and front-end equipment, positioning itself as a total solution provider in the semiconductor industry.

regional_presence.South Korea: Hanwha Semitech is part of the Hanwha Group, which has a significant presence in South Korea's semiconductor industry.
